# Emergency Medicine Physicians

In early 2015, North Canton-based Emergency Medicine Physicians (EMP) entered into an agreement with
funding partner, Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe, to form USACS, the national leader in
Physician-owned Integrated Acute Care. With the monumental market and regulatory shifts happening in
healthcare, forming USACS was the right move at the right time for the Physician group.

[ Contact Us arrow_forward_ios ][92]

## Becoming a World-Class Group

Now with the right capital partner, EMP has the necessary resources and experience to support growth
and ensure long-term future success. By joining a Physician-owned and led group with national scope,
EMP is better positioned to hire the best Physicians and Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in the
country, expand its solution offerings, and compete directly with large, publicly-owned healthcare
groups.

 

#### Building a Strong Foundation

When it came time to develop the new USACS model, it was important for EMP to assemble a group that
shared its values of "[Servant’s Heart. Owner’s Mind."][93] – a mantra now guiding USACS. EMP sought
out other Physician groups with a commitment to Physician ownership and patient-centered care, now
known as the USACS founding partners.

 

#### Since Founding USACS

In the time since founding USACS, EMP’s [PhysicianFirst][94] Emergency Department management system
has grown to reach a national audience and serve the needs of many USACS hospital partners.
Additionally, the [Patient Satisfaction Academy][95] and [Scholars Programs][96] have been leveraged
to deliver meaningful education and training for Physicians and APPs throughout the company.

country, expand its solution offerings, and compete directly with large, publicly-owned healthcare
groups.

 

#### Building a Strong Foundation

When it came time to develop the new USACS model, it was important for EMP to assemble a group that
shared its values of "[Servant’s Heart. Owner’s Mind."][93] – a mantra now guiding USACS. EMP sought
out other Physician groups with a commitment to Physician ownership and patient-centered care, now
known as the USACS founding partners.

 

#### Since Founding USACS

In the time since founding USACS, EMP’s [PhysicianFirst][94] Emergency Department management system
has grown to reach a national audience and serve the needs of many USACS hospital partners.
Additionally, the [Patient Satisfaction Academy][95] and [Scholars Programs][96] have been leveraged
to deliver meaningful education and training for Physicians and APPs throughout the company.

*The New Standard in craniofacial combat casualty dressing*

# About COMBATECT

COMBATECT was designed and developed by an internationally renowned neurosurgeon to optimize
battlefield craniofacial injury management. The very first step in craniofacial combat casualty
management is proper and efficient application of protective dressing, following adequate
hemostasis. Ideally, this dressing should add some degree of compression to the underlying wound to
aid in swelling reduction and hemostasis. 

## The Old Standard

· The current technique and the material used to dress the combat wounds to the head and face date
back to well before WWI, when the neurosurgical subspecialty was founded in the early 1900’s by Dr.
Harvey Cushing. Nothing, in terms of the technique or the material used, changed over the last
century! (**Picture on the left**)

· Its application requires a few minutes, and the failure rate (i.e. the dressing coming undone) is
high when not done properly. 

· It is also difficult, dangerous and time-consuming (taking minutes) to apply to wounded soldiers
on battle fields, requiring combat medics to assume the kneeled position, exposing themselves to
enemy fires.

· There is a dire need for the new standard craniofacial dressing to replace the archaic one.

## The New Military Standard

## Trust in COMBATECT

**COMBATECT is the new standard in craniofacial dressing technique & material which rectifies all of
the shortcomings associated with the old standard:**


* Fast on/off (in seconds) 
* Safe application for combat medics/corpsmen (may be done in the prone position)
* No failure rate (no dressing coming undone)
* Simple design allows for self-application by soldiers with minor wounds
* May be doubled as a garment to mediate/prevent hypothermia 
* Developed by Lee Surgical Innovations, Inc.
* FDA registered as a Class I medical device
* Patented (USPTO) 
* Trademark registered
* Made in the USA (Los Angeles, CA)

COMBATECT, the new standard, with 3 easy-to-apply components.

## SETTING THE STANDARD IN WOUND CARE THROUGH BOARD-CERTIFIED EXPERTISE

# ROYAL WOUND CARE

# Board-Certified Wound Care. Proven Expertise. Superior Outcomes.

## Experience advanced wound care designed around you—combining medical expertise, thoughtful
## treatment, and compassionate support at every stage of healing.

[Book Now][30]
[Mobile Wound Care][31]

## We Provide Expert, Compassionate Wound Care Services

## At Royal Wound Care, we simplify wound care by focusing on the core principles that drive
## effective healing and long-term recovery.

[Royal Wound Care who we are]

## **Who we are**

## At ***Royal Wound Care***, we specialize in treating chronic, non-healing wounds using today’s
## most advanced techniques—because every patient deserves expert care and a faster path to
## recovery.


Led by Dr. Moaddel, a ***board-certified wound*** specialist, our dedicated team delivers
compassionate, personalized treatment—whether at our West Hills clinic or directly within nursing
facilities throughout the San Fernando Valley.

## **What sets us apart**

## At* ****Royal Wound Care***, personalized care is more than a commitment—it’s our standard. As a
## locally operated, patient-focused clinic, we believe healing is best guided by both **expertise
## and compassion**.

## Our care is led by **board-certified wound care physicians**, reflecting advanced medical
## training and a focused dedication to wound healing as a specialty. This level of clinical
## expertise allows us to provide thoughtful, individualized treatment while maintaining the close,
## one-on-one attention larger organizations often can’t.

## You’re not just a case, you’re part of our community, and we’re here to support you through every
## step of your healing journey.

[Royal Wound Care what sets us apart]
[Specialized Wound Care at the Bedside]

# **Specialized Wound Care at the Bedside**

## We deliver expert wound care at the bedside to speed healing, reduce costly hospital
## readmissions, and help keep patients recovering comfortably at home.

[Advanced Clinical Modalities]

# **Advanced Clinical Modalities**

## We offer cutting-edge treatments including debridement, NPWT, skin substitutes, and infection
## control protocols—right where care is needed.

[Compliance Standards]

# **Compliance Standards**

## We follow CMS guidelines and proven practices to boost compliance, support surveys, and reduce
## regulatory risk—while working closely with your team.

[Provider Training & Clinical Support]

# Provider Training & Clinical Support

## We empower your team with on-site training and wound care certification—improving compliance,
## boosting outcomes, and strengthening in-house care.

## Every 30 seconds

## Someone loses a limb because of a wound that won’t heal.

[Royal Wound Care]

## If you’re dealing with something similar, you’re not alone—**there’s real help available.**

## Backed by ***board-certified professionals*** and leading-edge treatment, ***Royal Wound Care***
## gives patients the best chance at faster, more complete healing.

[WHY IS ADVANCED WOUND CARE IMPORTANT?][32]

## **Why Partner with Royal Wound Care?**

## Elevate Your SNF’s Standard of Care. Reduce Readmissions. Stay Survey-Ready.

## When it comes to skilled nursing facilities, wound care is the frontline of risk. Poor management
## leads to rehospitalizations, survey violations, frustrated families—and worst of all, preventable
## suffering. At ***Royal Wound Care***, we partner with **SNFs** to provide expert-level bedside
## wound and skincare services that protect your patients and your reputation.

[LEARN MORE][33]

### Frequently Asked Questions

Are your products Berry Compliant?

Yes, Safeguard Medical's product suite includes many Berry Compliant products. Please search "berry
compliant" for a list of these products. Additionally, an icon indicating a product is Berry
Compliant will appear on the product page for applicable products.

Are your products manufactured in the USA or another Trade Compliant Country?

Yes, Safeguard Medical's product suite includes many products that are made exclusively in the USA.
Please search "made in usa" for a list of these products. Additionally, an icon indicating a product
is Made in the USA will appear on the product page for applicable products.

Do you ship your products overseas to APO/AE addresses?

Yes, we ship our products globally to ensure responders have access to our products where and when
they need them most.

Do you accept Government Purchase Cards (GPC)?

Yes, we happily accept Government Purchase Cards (GPC) as a form of payment.

Do your products have National Stock Numbers (NSN)?

Yes, Safeguard Medical's product suite includes many products with NSNs. Please search for the NSN
you are looking for and that product will display. You may also find an NSN listed on each
individual product page if it is available for that product.

# Emergency Medicine Physicians

In early 2015, North Canton-based Emergency Medicine Physicians (EMP) entered into an agreement with
funding partner, Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe, to form USACS, the national leader in
Physician-owned Integrated Acute Care. With the monumental market and regulatory shifts happening in
healthcare, forming USACS was the right move at the right time for the Physician group.

[ Contact Us arrow_forward_ios ][92]

## Becoming a World-Class Group

Now with the right capital partner, EMP has the necessary resources and experience to support growth
and ensure long-term future success. By joining a Physician-owned and led group with national scope,
EMP is better positioned to hire the best Physicians and Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in the
country, expand its solution offerings, and compete directly with large, publicly-owned healthcare
groups.

 

#### Building a Strong Foundation

When it came time to develop the new USACS model, it was important for EMP to assemble a group that
shared its values of "[Servant’s Heart. Owner’s Mind."][93] – a mantra now guiding USACS. EMP sought
out other Physician groups with a commitment to Physician ownership and patient-centered care, now
known as the USACS founding partners.

 

#### Since Founding USACS

In the time since founding USACS, EMP’s [PhysicianFirst][94] Emergency Department management system
has grown to reach a national audience and serve the needs of many USACS hospital partners.
Additionally, the [Patient Satisfaction Academy][95] and [Scholars Programs][96] have been leveraged
to deliver meaningful education and training for Physicians and APPs throughout the company.

Who We Are

## About Lifesaving Systems

Lifesaving Systems has been serving the world’s Search and Rescue (SAR) responders within the
Aviation and Marine sectors since 1980. Our company specializes in providing rescue, safety, and
survival equipment not only for SAR responders but also for industry professionals and operators
working in the maritime and aviation environments. Clients include all branches of the US Military,
foreign militaries, police and fire departments worldwide,  both international and domestic civilian
helicopter operators and rescue agencies.

From personal protective equipment (US Coast Guard approved life jackets) to technical helicopter
rescue devices (strops and litters), Lifesaving Systems is the source for your SAR, safety, and
survival equipment requirements. The company maintains an extensive inventory of new equipment to
promptly meet customer requirements.

**We are uniquely positioned with design and manufacturing capabilities as well as distributing
other top manufacturers’ products.** Constantly seeking to improve product functionality for our end
users, we led an industry wide advancement of LED Technology and design in the strobe light market.
In addition, our in-house design and manufacturing capabilities allow us to accommodate special
end-user requirements. That may include a simple modification to an existing product or start a new
development project. Core manufacturing competencies include:
* **Technical Textiles:** Rescue Harnesses, Inflatable Life Vests, Strops, Tethers, etc.
* **Specialty Aviation and Marine Hardware:** Stainless Steel and Titanium Hooks, Buckles, etc.
* **Metal Fabrication:** Stainless Steel and Titanium Litters, Baskets & Rescue Devices.
* **Specialty Electronics **

Through constant innovation and application of new technologies, Lifesaving Systems has established
itself as the leading supplier of rescue and survival solutions to the most demanding military and
professional customers.

# It's QuikClot^{®} or it's not.

A proprietary technology, which consists of a non-woven material impregnated with Kaolin. Kaolin
activates Factor XII,¹ which in turn accelerates the clotting cascade^{2,3,4,5} leading to faster
bleeding control.^{8,9,10}

[Explore Our Products][31]

## Innovating Hemostasis:

### QuikClot’s proprietary technology

[Hourglass]

### ACTIVATES.

Kaolin activates Factor XII¹

[Rocket]

### ACCELERATES.

Accelerates the clotting cascade^{2,3,4,5}

[Hourglass]

### Formation.

Robust clot formation^{6,7}

[Hourglass]

*The New Standard in craniofacial combat casualty dressing*

# About COMBATECT

COMBATECT was designed and developed by an internationally renowned neurosurgeon to optimize
battlefield craniofacial injury management. The very first step in craniofacial combat casualty
management is proper and efficient application of protective dressing, following adequate
hemostasis. Ideally, this dressing should add some degree of compression to the underlying wound to
aid in swelling reduction and hemostasis. 

## The Old Standard

· The current technique and the material used to dress the combat wounds to the head and face date
back to well before WWI, when the neurosurgical subspecialty was founded in the early 1900’s by Dr.
Harvey Cushing. Nothing, in terms of the technique or the material used, changed over the last
century! (**Picture on the left**)

· Its application requires a few minutes, and the failure rate (i.e. the dressing coming undone) is
high when not done properly. 

· It is also difficult, dangerous and time-consuming (taking minutes) to apply to wounded soldiers
on battle fields, requiring combat medics to assume the kneeled position, exposing themselves to
enemy fires.

· There is a dire need for the new standard craniofacial dressing to replace the archaic one.

## The New Military Standard

## Trust in COMBATECT

**COMBATECT is the new standard in craniofacial dressing technique & material which rectifies all of
the shortcomings associated with the old standard:**


* Fast on/off (in seconds) 
* Safe application for combat medics/corpsmen (may be done in the prone position)
* No failure rate (no dressing coming undone)
* Simple design allows for self-application by soldiers with minor wounds
* May be doubled as a garment to mediate/prevent hypothermia 
* Developed by Lee Surgical Innovations, Inc.
* FDA registered as a Class I medical device
* Patented (USPTO) 
* Trademark registered
* Made in the USA (Los Angeles, CA)

COMBATECT, the new standard, with 3 easy-to-apply components.

## Chicago’s Local Medical Home Healthcare Agency for Seniors

At Essential Home Health Care, we are committed to being Chicagoland’s top choice for senior and
elder care. We understand the challenges that come with ensuring your loved ones receive the best
possible care, especially when they wish to maintain their independence at home. Our agency
specializes in providing compassionate, personalized services tailored to the unique needs of older
adults. Whether your loved one requires physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or
post-surgical care, our dedicated team is here to support them every step of the way.

We recognize that adult children often play a crucial role in coordinating care for their aging
parents. That’s why we work closely with families to create customized care plans that promote
health, safety, and peace of mind. With Essential Home Health Care, you can trust that your loved
ones are receiving expert care that respects their dignity and enhances their quality of life—all in
the comfort of their own home.

### Non- Medical Home Care & Home Health Aide Services

It is important to note that Essential is not a home care or home maker agency, but a medical
healthcare agency.  We provide nursing and therapy primarily through medicare insurance.

## Our Mission

To assist our clients in maintaining a safe and healthy home environment conductive to achieving the
highest level of functional independence in the comfort of their homes.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

this is data you can trust.

compassionate, personalized treatment—whether at our West Hills clinic or directly within nursing
facilities throughout the San Fernando Valley.

## training and a focused dedication to wound healing as a specialty. This level of clinical

About company TahatAksi

TahatAksi is a family-owned company incorporated in 1994 in Minsk, Belarus. The company has
established itself as a fast-growing manufacturer of medical equipment, specializing in hypothermia
prevention and treatment systems and equipment for both newborns and adults. TahatAksi produces a
range of medical devices, including warming systems for infants, patient warming systems, blood and
infusion warmers, blood and plasma thawers, and warming cabinets for medical fluids and blankets.

Hospital equipment manufacturing company TahatAksi is recognized for its commitment to quality,
implementing a Total Quality Control System that is certified under EN ISO 9001:2015 and EN ISO
13485:2016 standards. Our TAHAT products have also received CE certification, ensuring compliance
with European medical device regulations. TahatAksi serves over 35 countries worldwide and is known
for its focus on creating cost-effective, advanced solutions that meet the demands of healthcare
professionals.

Areas of care
TahatAksi offers advanced solutions in several key medical fields, focusing on improving patient
care and treatment through qualitative high-quality equipment. Manufacturing hospital equipment
include:
* Prevention and Treatment of Hypothermia
  TahatAksi manufactures warming systems for newborns and adults to prevent inadvertent hypothermia
  during perioperative periods or critical and intensive care. These include portable and stationary
  devices to maintain patients’ core body temperature effectively.
* Infant Care
  TAHAT manufactures newborn warming systems, such as the RAMONAK series, designed to ensure thermal
  support for infants in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and maternity and obstetrics clinics
  and hospitals.
* Blood and Infusion Solutions Warming
  TahatAksi offers a variety of blood and fluid warming devices, including the AMPIR-01 and
  AMPIRMini series, which ensure that IV fluids and blood products are safely warmed before infusion
  into patients, reducing risks associated with cold infusions. Healthcare facilities looking to buy
  medical equipment for safe infusions will find these solutions critical.
* Medical Warming Cabinets
  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.
* Plasma Thawing Devices
  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.
* Our mission
  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

## About Lifesaving Systems

Lifesaving Systems has been serving the world’s Search and Rescue (SAR) responders within the
Aviation and Marine sectors since 1980. Our company specializes in providing rescue, safety, and
survival equipment not only for SAR responders but also for industry professionals and operators
working in the maritime and aviation environments. Clients include all branches of the US Military,
foreign militaries, police and fire departments worldwide,  both international and domestic civilian
helicopter operators and rescue agencies.

From personal protective equipment (US Coast Guard approved life jackets) to technical helicopter
rescue devices (strops and litters), Lifesaving Systems is the source for your SAR, safety, and
survival equipment requirements. The company maintains an extensive inventory of new equipment to
promptly meet customer requirements.

**We are uniquely positioned with design and manufacturing capabilities as well as distributing
other top manufacturers’ products.** Constantly seeking to improve product functionality for our end
users, we led an industry wide advancement of LED Technology and design in the strobe light market.
In addition, our in-house design and manufacturing capabilities allow us to accommodate special
end-user requirements. That may include a simple modification to an existing product or start a new
development project. Core manufacturing competencies include:
* **Technical Textiles:** Rescue Harnesses, Inflatable Life Vests, Strops, Tethers, etc.
* **Specialty Aviation and Marine Hardware:** Stainless Steel and Titanium Hooks, Buckles, etc.
* **Metal Fabrication:** Stainless Steel and Titanium Litters, Baskets & Rescue Devices.
* **Specialty Electronics **

Through constant innovation and application of new technologies, Lifesaving Systems has established
itself as the leading supplier of rescue and survival solutions to the most demanding military and
professional customers.

Working, studying or living abroad? Our international health insurance plans help protect expat
individuals, professionals, students and families as they work and live abroad. Explore our plans
and choose the international expat healthcare cover that’s perfect for you. Only away for less than
a year? Discover our short-term private health insurance for individuals and families.

cover for insurance risks, or a combination of both.

###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to

###  
###  
###

###  
###

## Introducing Our Most Advanced Waterproof Bandages

100% waterproof first aid bandages help block out water, dirt, and germs that may cause infection.
These sterile adhesive bandages are waterproof, even through hand washing, to help protect minor
wounds.

## Chicago’s Local Medical Home Healthcare Agency for Seniors

At Essential Home Health Care, we are committed to being Chicagoland’s top choice for senior and
elder care. We understand the challenges that come with ensuring your loved ones receive the best
possible care, especially when they wish to maintain their independence at home. Our agency
specializes in providing compassionate, personalized services tailored to the unique needs of older
adults. Whether your loved one requires physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or
post-surgical care, our dedicated team is here to support them every step of the way.

We recognize that adult children often play a crucial role in coordinating care for their aging
parents. That’s why we work closely with families to create customized care plans that promote
health, safety, and peace of mind. With Essential Home Health Care, you can trust that your loved
ones are receiving expert care that respects their dignity and enhances their quality of life—all in
the comfort of their own home.

### Non- Medical Home Care & Home Health Aide Services

It is important to note that Essential is not a home care or home maker agency, but a medical
healthcare agency.  We provide nursing and therapy primarily through medicare insurance.

## Our Mission

To assist our clients in maintaining a safe and healthy home environment conductive to achieving the
highest level of functional independence in the comfort of their homes.

About company TahatAksi

TahatAksi is a family-owned company incorporated in 1994 in Minsk, Belarus. The company has
established itself as a fast-growing manufacturer of medical equipment, specializing in hypothermia
prevention and treatment systems and equipment for both newborns and adults. TahatAksi produces a
range of medical devices, including warming systems for infants, patient warming systems, blood and
infusion warmers, blood and plasma thawers, and warming cabinets for medical fluids and blankets.

Hospital equipment manufacturing company TahatAksi is recognized for its commitment to quality,
implementing a Total Quality Control System that is certified under EN ISO 9001:2015 and EN ISO
13485:2016 standards. Our TAHAT products have also received CE certification, ensuring compliance
with European medical device regulations. TahatAksi serves over 35 countries worldwide and is known
for its focus on creating cost-effective, advanced solutions that meet the demands of healthcare
professionals.

Areas of care
TahatAksi offers advanced solutions in several key medical fields, focusing on improving patient
care and treatment through qualitative high-quality equipment. Manufacturing hospital equipment
include:
* Prevention and Treatment of Hypothermia
  TahatAksi manufactures warming systems for newborns and adults to prevent inadvertent hypothermia
  during perioperative periods or critical and intensive care. These include portable and stationary
  devices to maintain patients’ core body temperature effectively.
* Infant Care
  TAHAT manufactures newborn warming systems, such as the RAMONAK series, designed to ensure thermal
  support for infants in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and maternity and obstetrics clinics
  and hospitals.
* Blood and Infusion Solutions Warming
  TahatAksi offers a variety of blood and fluid warming devices, including the AMPIR-01 and
  AMPIRMini series, which ensure that IV fluids and blood products are safely warmed before infusion
  into patients, reducing risks associated with cold infusions. Healthcare facilities looking to buy
  medical equipment for safe infusions will find these solutions critical.
* Medical Warming Cabinets
  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.
* Plasma Thawing Devices
  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.
* Our mission
  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

[2]: /oem/ treat-on.com # Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.
